artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: repair merge_spec's broken host fixture to a green baseline, move deep_merge's tracking insert outside the dedup guard, add a still-declared-by-another-loaded-extension guard to unmerge_settings and plumb it through manager.unload, add six spec cases, document the tracking contract and real repair route, then repair the four stale records via a plain redeploy under the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: finding is: manager.wipe/[Regenerate] does NOT repair a stale merge-tracking record in .claude-extensions.json, contrary to a prior research finding. manager.wipe snapshots settings.json and settings.local.json (settings_backup.BACKUP_FILES) before rm -rf .claude, and manager.regenerate calls settings_backup.restore BEFORE manager.resync_all. The restored settings.local.json reinstates every already-present grant as the merge base, so deep_merge's dedup-before-track check fires exactly as it does on an ordinary resync and the tracking record comes back empty. The real repair for a stale record is a plain redeploy (bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh, bootstrap load + resync_all) run AFTER the deep_merge tracking fix lands -- the engine fix is itself the repair mechanism.
